A.text: Jev is TypeSafe's hosted model. Instead of generating text, it answers typed questions — pick one, yes/no, score — with probabilities. Within a week of its release, seven open-source look-alikes had appeared, so we installed all seven. We ran 14 configurations of them, one at a time, on a single 8 GB consumer GPU, and scored every one on the same 764 out-of-domain decisions. We also ran Jev itself through TypeSafe's API alongside them. The clear pick is Kev-4B quantized to 4-bit. It fits in 3.7 GB, lands 4.7 points behind Jev at the same speed, gives fewer confidently wrong answers, and has no per-call cost.
